runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 9.9.2026 08:42 across 10 independent source families, 9 outside Profesia. No new promotion-grade unique job was found. Kariera surfaced existing/adjacent Bratislava support roles; Upwork produced fresh worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce jobs but they were low-budget, Expert/hard-development, strong-English or high-competition. Reddit results were FOR HIRE providers, not hiring demand. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.
